description: List technical Level of Service targets for building systems. One base target per system and metric, set once for the organization. Each building is held to a version adjusted by its criticality: a lower-is-better target is multiplied by the tier's modifier, a higher-is-better one keeps its distance from a perfect score multiplied by it (condition 70 becomes 82 at a Critical facility, 58 at a Low one). Derived targets never leave the metric's scale. Metrics: fci (0-100 percent, lower is better), asset_condition_avg (0-100, higher is better, read with the fixed condition bands), asset_past_useful_life_pct (0-100 percent, lower is better), risk_score_avg (0-25, lower is better). None of these values are money. Filter by system, metric or active.

page.description: Page number (default: all pages fetched automatically)

per_page.description: Items per page (default: 1000, max: 1000). All pages are fetched automatically.
